metadata.name: Kora - 3D Creative Agency
metadata.description: Animated 3D portfolio for a creative agency. A glossy bunny mascot travels through three WebGL scenes with refraction, bloom and kinetic type, then hands off to a dark contact scene with a floating iridescent form and a contact form. Next.js 16, React 19 and Three.js; scroll, drag, keyboard and dot navigation; the renderer pauses off-screen.
metadata.author: lyanchouss
